name: Kimotsuki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kimotsuki town emblem in light blue, green and orange: light blue and green stylised feathers with an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kimotsuki, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 February 2006.

features.role: Kimotsuki town emblem — light blue and green stylised feathers with an orange disc
